description: Validate a Czech IČO via the ČSÚ Mod-11 checksum. Pure function — does not call ARES. Returns the normalized 8-digit IČO and whether the checksum is valid.

ico.description: Czech IČO (Identifikační číslo osoby). Accepts 1–8 digits, optional 'CZ' prefix, whitespace, dashes or dots. Examples: '27074358', 'CZ27074358', '270 743 58'.

name: ares_validate_ico
